Easy High-protein Fluffy Pancakes🤩 These pancakes are one of my favorite recipes and so many of you have already tried them out😍 Follow for more yummy breakfast ideas😋
•
Ingredients:
1 egg
3/4 cup Greek yogurt (180 ml)
1 - 2 teaspoons maple syrup (or brown sugar)
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 cup gluten-free flour mix (or regular flour if not coeliac/intolerant/IBS sufferer) (120 ml)
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
•
1. Mix the wet ingredients together
2. Add the dry ingredients and stir until combined (if the batter seems too thick, add a couple of tablespoons more yogurt)
3. Cook on a non stick skillet for a few minutes on each side
4. Serve with berries & a little bit of maple syrup, for example

⚠️ THIS IS NOT A DRILL - top tier train hack status ⚠️ and you’re still in time to use this on your Christmas trains 🚝🎄

💾 Save this for the future and tag someone who is gonna LOVE this hack

👩‍💻 Full info and how it works over on ⬇️ 
cheapholidayexpert.com (it’s currently on the homepage!)

And for now, here’s the quick debrief:

🚆Avanti Superfare matches empty seats with customers who have a bit of flexibility 
🚆This works by customers booking a ticket for their intended date of travel, but instead of selecting a time they can only select morning, afternoon or evening

🚆24 hours before their trip, Avanti will confirm what train they will be on - and assign them a seat

It’s pretty clever right?! Because Avanti can fill up their emptier trains and we can get a much cheaper seat.

Speaking of costs…

Here’s some example fares from London (one way):

🚄 London ➡️ Birmingham - £9
🚄 London ➡️ Manchester - £20
🚄 London ➡️ Liverpool - £15
🚄 London ➡️ Preston - £22
🚄 London ➡️ Glasgow - £30
🚄 London ➡️ Stafford - £12
🚄 London ➡️ Crewe - £14
🚄 London ➡️ Stoke-On-Trent - £14
🚄 London ➡️ Warrington - £15
🚄 London ➡️ Runcorn - £15
🚄 London ➡️ Macclesfield - £16
🚄 London ➡️ Wilmslow - £18
🚄 London ➡️ Stockport - £20
🚄 London ➡️ Wigan - £20
🚄 London ➡️ Lancaster - £25

These prices are set, and work vice versa. You also don’t have to start your journey in London - these are just examples!

The main things to bear in mind are:

⚠️ You can only book between 7 - 21 days so if you’re after Christmas fares - GO GO GO
⚠️ You can’t use a railcard
⚠️ You can’t change your ticket or get a refund

I honestly think it’s SO GOOD. 

Eurostar used to have something very similar called ‘Eurostar snap’ (bring it back pleeeeeease) and I’d love to see more train networks doing this 👍

I also fear that for those of you who did know this, you’re gonna hate me for sharing this… I’M SORRY GUYS BUT IT’S JUST TOO GOOD TO NOT SHARE 🙏

The viral MASSIVE CROISSANT trend has hit Edinburgh! IMO they would probably feed 4-5 people and would be such a good option for someone’s birthday if they’re not a fan of cake! #eatinburgh

Best lobster pasta in London? 👀🦞

📍Victoria
💸 £80-£100 po.
🍝 Cicchetti/Italian

🇬🇧 Today is Lobster Day so I thought it would be the right time to re share this amazing lobster pasta by @tozirestaurant ❤️ I’ve been to Tozi several times and it’s definitely one of the best Italian restaurants in London for me! Tozi specialises in cicchetti, Venetian “tapas”, but they also have regular dishes. 

Here’s what I had: 

🦀 Soft shell crab, chilli, salsa verde 
🦐 Prawn carpaccio 
🍆 Aubergine parmigiana (10/10!!)
🦞 Lobster pasta 
🍰 Pistachio tiramisù

_______________
🇮🇹 Oggi è National Lobster Day e ne volevo approfittare per condividere una pasta all’astice che mi è piaciuta un sacco! Sono stata diverse volte da Tozi e per me è sicuramente uno dei migliori ristoranti italiani a Londra. Tozi serve principalmente cicchetti veneziani, ma hanno anche piatti “regolari”. Ecco cosa ho provato:

🦀 Granchio fritto 
🦐 Carpaccio di gamberi
🍆 Melanzane alla parmigiana (10/10!!)
🦞 spaghetti all’aragosta
🍰 Tiramisù al pistacchio
